benchmarks.notes: Equal 0.04 qty, 7.00 USDT strategy cap, excludes funding & entry/exit fees.
Applies the exact 8 observed Demo funding charges (-0.09763384 USDT); conservative lower bound because pre-09:00Z funding rates are not booked while flat.
100% deployed 7.00 USDT 1x exposure (higher capital utilization than Grid 0.04 qty).
CRITICAL CAVEAT: Grid avoided the -17.6% drop during Gen 0 ONLY because its BUY order was canceled on Nov 15 and the Windows runner was offline for ~6 days, NOT because of active hedge alpha.
NOT risk-matched: 1.000x account leverage vs Demo Grid's ~0.0010x effective account leverage (~960x exposure disparity). Included solely to prevent naive account-% comparisons.
Full account span includes Pre-Grid smoke round-trip (-0.0289 USDT) + Grid (+0.0344 USDT).

capital_basis_metrics.note: Explicitly separates total Demo account equity (5000 USDT), Grid strategy committed-cash cap (7.00 USDT), and peak deployed position notional (5.1836 USDT). Cumulative order notional is turnover, NOT net invested capital.

delay_counterfactual.note: Counterfactual assumes zero-fee maker exit at first breakout close; actual delay occurred while Windows runner was offline/pre-F11 before Azure C05 cutover.

historical_replay.demo_7usdt_cap_infeasibility_note: At May-Aug 2026 NVDAUSDT prices (170-225 USDT), 0.04 units requires 6.8-9.0 USDT notional, exceeding the current Demo max_cash_committed=7.00 USDT cap in most windows. Replay uses 10.00 USDT 1x collateral so single-level ±1% Grid mechanics can be evaluated across regimes.
